q: This paper proposes a specification-based Code–Text–Code reengineering framework for LLM-mediated software evolution.
r: IC1: a code-to-spec-to-code translation framework for LLMs; agents are only future work, so it is not SDD with coding agents, context files or agent evaluation.

q: We present DesignSpecs, a research dataset dedicated to token-bearing DESIGN.
r: IC1: a dataset of DESIGN.md files with no evaluation of coding agents or effect on cost or quality; not clearly in scope.

q: we perform two case studies to demonstrate the effectiveness of state-of-the-art LMA frameworks.
r: Include: systematic review of LLM multi-agent systems for software development with two case studies of MetaGPT-style frameworks building an application.
